newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen appoints new central bank governor.
newsitem.headline: Yemen appoints new central bank governor.

text.p: Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh on Sunday appointed Ahmad Abdul-Rahman al-Samawi, a former minister of economy, as the country's new central bank governor.
Samawi, also a former chairman of the board of directors of the Yemen Bank for Reconstruction and Development, replaces outgoing governor Alwai Saleh al-Salami.
A presidential decree announcing the appointment was broadcast on official Yemeni television.

A separate presidential decree carried by the television said Ahmad Mohammad Soufan, industry minister in the country's new government after April elections, was appointed chairman of the Yemen Investment Authority.
